title: Vendor Invoice Audit: Agency Overbilling Credits under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement
content:
**Rule.** Under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, an agency credit is taken against the claim's latest agency payment. The following are read from the rental ledger:
- the payment's billed days, billed daily rate and amount;
- the daily rate recorded on the authorization the payment bills;
- that authorization's authorized days, with every extension;
- its closing end date, and why it closed.

A credit is recorded once per payment. The credit lowers the rental benefit paid and gives the credited amount back to the per-loss benefit of the claim.

## Effect of recording a credit

Each credit records one agency credit on the claim's rental ledger, tied to the agency payment it is taken against. The credited amount is taken off the rental benefit paid on the option and given back to the claim's per-loss benefit, and the agency's account shows the credit.

## Tool

The tool is `record_agency_overbilling_credit_d02c6cb6`, an agent-side tool. The representative unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_coverage_id` | Reference number of the rental reimbursement option the payment was made under, from the rental option lookup for the damaged vehicle | Identifier |
| `customer_id` | Customer reference number of the named insured, from the customer profile lookup | Identifier |
| `claim_number` | Physical damage claim number of the loss, from the claim or rental ledger lookup | Identifier |
| `source_entry_id` | Reference number of the agency payment entry the credit is taken against, as shown on that payment in the rental ledger lookup | Identifier |
| `amount` | Amount the agency credits back | US dollars, 2 decimal places, positive |

## Return

On success the tool returns:
- the word "credited" as the status;
- the reference number of the credit entry;
- the agency payment the credit is taken against;
- the amount credited (US dollars, 2 decimal places);
- the date recorded (YYYY-MM-DD).

## Basis Q&A

- *Which payment does the credit sit against?* The claim's latest agency payment.
- *Can the same payment carry a second agency credit?* No. A credit is recorded once per payment.
